slots.purpose: Set a calm, unsold, luxury tone for the decision: two beautiful stones, no verdict implied.
slots.shot_brief: Two similar loose round brilliant diamonds resting side by side on soft ivory linen or pale travertine, a jeweller's loupe in soft focus behind. Neither stone labelled or favoured. Late-morning window light, crisp sparkle, shallow depth of field, generous negative space for a title crop. No people. No real place. Landscape 3:2. Licensed photography preferred (stock bought by a human and registered in library-index.csv, or a commissioned shoot). No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.

slots.purpose: Explain HPHT and CVD in one glance so the plain-words paragraph lands.
slots.shot_brief: Simple two-panel brand diagram. Left 'HPHT (high pressure, high temperature)': a press squeezing a capsule with a small diamond seed, carbon source and heat arrows. Right 'CVD (chemical vapour deposition)': a chamber with a flat diamond seed plate, carbon-rich gas and a glowing plasma layer building the crystal up in layers. A small shared footnote panel: 'Some stones are treated after growth'. Clean line art, brand palette on cream or white, Australian English labels, no figures for temperatures or pressures unless the writer's sourced text supplies them. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.
sourcing_notes: Library and Drive: nothing licensed (register empty; no new search this run per fast-mode instruction; sister posts diamond-buying-guide and engagement-ring-styles found nothing licensed, RAKTDA Drive ring files unlicensed).

Best built in Canva as own artwork with own wording (labels must be accurate and legible; AI renders text unreliably). AI may supply generic stone or chamber artwork only, labelled 'Illustrative image'. Not generated this run.
Writer and editor to check the diagram matches the GIA-sourced paragraph before export.

slots.purpose: Show that a lab-grown and a mined diamond look the same to the eye, and that simulants are a different thing.
slots.shot_brief: Still life: two near-identical loose round brilliant diamonds side by side on a soft grey grading tray, small neutral tent cards reading only 'A' and 'B' (not 'lab' or 'natural'), so the image makes the point that the eye cannot tell. Optional third stone set slightly apart and labelled 'Simulant' only if the caption explains it. Diffused daylight, true-to-life colour, editorial and uncluttered. No people, or one anonymous cropped hand with tweezers. No real place. Landscape 3:2. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.

slots.purpose: Show what a girdle laser inscription looks like and that you need magnification to see it.
slots.shot_brief: Macro close-up of a diamond's girdle edge under magnification with a fine laser-inscribed line, fictional and illegible or clearly generic text such as 'LAB-GROWN 0000000' (no real report number, no real lab prefix or logo). Option B: a simple brand diagram of a loupe over the girdle with a callout. Dark or soft grey background, sharp focus on the girdle, no people. Landscape 3:2 or square. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.

slots.purpose: Show what to look for on a lab-grown grading report (origin statement, report number, inscription, quality description) without showing a real report.
slots.shot_brief: Generic, fictional mock-up built in Canva by the team: an invented neutral layout, the word 'SAMPLE' across it, placeholder report number clearly fake ('Report no. 0000000000'), labelled callouts to origin statement ('Laboratory-grown diamond'), report number, shape and measurements, quality description, growth method or post-growth treatment note where a report gives it, and laser inscription. Flat, top-down, brand palette. Never a real GIA or IGI report, no lab name or logo anywhere, no copy of either lab's layout, fonts, colours or security features. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.

slots.purpose: Ground durability in everyday wear: the stone in a secure setting on a real hand, at ease.
slots.shot_brief: One anonymous hand (no face) wearing a solitaire engagement ring in a low-profile, secure setting such as a bezel or low prongs, relaxed natural gesture, for example resting on a linen napkin or holding a coffee cup at a sunlit table. Natural daylight, editorial and warm. Not captioned as a real wedding, a real venue or a lab-grown stone unless proven. No identifiable person without consent; no recognisable jeweller design. Portrait 4:5 or landscape 3:2. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.

slots.purpose: Give a skimmable, saveable summary of 'worth it if / think twice if' and the paperwork to ask for.
slots.shot_brief: Brand graphic in Canva: two balanced columns, 'Worth it if' and 'Think twice if', with three to four short points each taken word for word from the final article, plus a slim footer strip 'Either way, ask for: origin in writing, report number, inscription check'. Equal visual weight for both columns so neither option is favoured. Brand palette and fonts, cream background, generous spacing, readable on mobile. Square or 4:5. No logos other than Wedded Wonderland. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Never copy GIA or IGI diagrams, photos or report layouts.
